sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown (📊): added an "Instrument info - Cross-reference" section for `instrument-list`'s first-column cells — a more specific facet of the existing "Instrument info - Description" flag, true only when the description contains a REAL `<a>` link to another instrument (e.g. a family entry naming its members, or a "not to be confused with X" note), not merely free text. Deliberately excludes MusicBrainz's own literal escaped `<a href=...>` text (seen in real data, e.g. the "bazooka"/"bouzouki" cross-reference), which renders as plain text, not a link. Did not exist before this — see org/column-unique-value-drop-down-menu.org's "Analysis results" suggestion #5. New: `_findCellInstrumentFacets()` gained a `hasCrossReference` facet (alongside its existing `hasComment`/`hasDescription`), a new `instrument-has-crossreference` fixed structure-mode, and `_highlightInstrumentCrossReferenceMatch()` (marks each cross-reference link's own text individually, not the whole description).
